name: Nivel 3 — Calidad integral

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Responsive, accesibilidad, rendimiento, SEO y UI/UX
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Rebuild diagnostics in runner
        run: npm run build:pages

      - name: Audit Phase 8 UI/UX
        id: phase8_ui
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run audit:phase8-ui > phase8-ui-audit.log 2>&1

      - name: Run final static audit
        id: final_static
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run audit:final > phase8-final-audit.log 2>&1

      - name: Run Level 3 static audit
        id: level3
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run audit:level3 > level3-quality-audit.log 2>&1

      - name: Install Chromium
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Test all pages in canonical viewports
        id: canonical
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run audit:canonical-viewports > canonical-viewports.log 2>&1

      - name: Start local site
        run: |
          node scripts/servidor-local-pruebas.mjs 4173 > /tmp/tintin-quality-http.log 2>&1 &
          for attempt in {1..30}; do
            curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4173/index.html >/dev/null && exit 0
            sleep 1
          done
          cat /tmp/tintin-quality-http.log
          exit 1

      - name: Test Phase 8 UI/UX in Chromium
        id: phase8_browser
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:4173
        run: npm run test:phase8-ui > phase8-ui-browser.log 2>&1

      - name: Measure Phase 5 Web Vitals
        id: phase5_performance
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          PERF_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:4173
        run: |
          set +e
          npx playwright test tests/performance/public-pages.performance.spec.js --project=chromium > phase5-performance.log 2>&1
          status=$?
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            message=${line//'%'/'%25'}
            message=${message//$'\r'/'%0D'}
            message=${message//$'\n'/'%0A'}
            echo "::notice title=Phase 5 Web Vitals::$message"
          done < <(grep -E '^\[[^]]+\.html\] DCL=' phase5-performance.log || true)
          exit "$status"

      - name: Upload Level 3 reports and generated manifest
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: level3-quality-reports
          path: |
            diagnostic-manifest.json
            phase8-ui-audit.log
            phase8-final-audit.log
            phase8-ui-browser.log
            level3-quality-audit.log
            canonical-viewports.log
            phase5-performance.log
            artifacts/canonical-viewports
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Enforce quality results
        run: |
          cat phase8-ui-audit.log
          cat phase8-final-audit.log
          cat phase8-ui-browser.log
          cat level3-quality-audit.log
          cat canonical-viewports.log
          cat phase5-performance.log
          test "${{ steps.phase8_ui.outcome }}" = "success"
          test "${{ steps.final_static.outcome }}" = "success"
          test "${{ steps.phase8_browser.outcome }}" = "success"
          test "${{ steps.level3.outcome }}" = "success"
          test "${{ steps.canonical.outcome }}" = "success"
          test "${{ steps.phase5_performance.outcome }}" = "success"

      - name: Verify generated diagnostics
        run: npm run verify:diagnostics

      - name: Confirm workflow leaves repository clean
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -f \
            phase8-ui-audit.log \
            phase8-final-audit.log \
            phase8-ui-browser.log \
            level3-quality-audit.log \
            canonical-viewports.log \
            phase5-performance.log
          rm -rf artifacts/canonical-viewports
          git restore diagnostic-manifest.json
          git diff --exit-code

        uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Configurar Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Revisar sintaxis
        run: |
          node --check js/core/firebase/firebase.js
          node --check js/components/images/utilidades-imagenes.js
          node --check js/components/images/imagenes.js
          node --check js/components/images/resolucion-imagenes.js
          node --check js/components/images/gestion-imagenes.js

          node --check js/diagnostic-shims/adaptador-almacenamiento.js
          node --check js/core/store/estado-productos.js
          node --check js/analytics/actividad-sitio.js
          node --check js/quality/calidad-interfaz.js
          node --check cloudflare/seguridad-cloudinary.js
          node --check functions/api/cloudinary-sign-upload.js
          node --check functions/api/cloudinary-delete.js

          node --check scripts/auditar-sitio-confiabilidad.js

          set -o pipefail

        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: wrangler-build-log
          path: wrangler-build.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Revisar integración
        run: npm run audit:images
      - name: Revisar confiabilidad
        id: reliability
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run audit:reliability > image-reliability-audit.log 2>&1
      - name: Guardar informe de confiabilidad
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: image-reliability-audit-log
          path: image-reliability-audit.log
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Exigir resultado de confiabilidad
        run: |
          cat image-reliability-audit.log
          test "${{ steps.reliability.outcome }}" = "success"

name: Auditoría visual Parte 2E

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  institutional-help-legal:
    name: Institucionales, ayuda y legales
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install Playwright
        run: npm install --no-save --package-lock=false

      - name: Install Chromium
        run: npx playwright install chromium

      # Este primer recorrido conserva continue-on-error porque produce el
      # reporte bruto que el paso siguiente clasifica. Algunos hallazgos del
      # reporte son estados colapsados o controles intencionales y no deben
      # convertir por sí solos el job en rojo.
      - name: Audit institutional help and legal pages
        id: part2e_audit
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          node scripts/auditar-institucional-ayuda-legal-parte-2e-v2.mjs 2>&1 | tee institutional-help-legal-part2e-raw.log

      # Este paso sí representa el resultado visual accionable. Si falla,
      # GitHub mostrará directamente este nombre en rojo y el log completo.
      - name: Enforce actionable visual findings
        id: part2e_enforce
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          node scripts/exigir-institucional-ayuda-legal-parte-2e.mjs 2>&1 | tee institutional-help-legal-part2e.log

      # Se ejecuta incluso si la geometría falla, para que el artefacto final
      # contenga ambos diagnósticos. Sin continue-on-error: un fallo queda
      # señalado aquí, no escondido detrás de un gate genérico posterior.
      - name: Audit FAQ interactions
        id: part2e_faq
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          node scripts/auditar-faq-interaccion-parte-2e.mjs 2>&1 | tee institutional-help-legal-part2e-faq.log

      - name: Upload report and screenshots
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: institutional-help-legal-part2e-report
          path: |
            institutional-help-legal-part2e.log
            institutional-help-legal-part2e-raw.log
            institutional-help-legal-part2e-faq.log
            artifacts/institutional-help-legal-part2e
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

name: Auditoría y limpieza segura de ramas

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - scripts/auditar-limpiar-ramas.mjs
      - tests/branches/auditar-limpiar-ramas.test.mjs
      - .github/workflows/auditar-limpiar-ramas.yml
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - scripts/auditar-limpiar-ramas.mjs
      - tests/branches/auditar-limpiar-ramas.test.mjs
      - .github/workflows/auditar-limpiar-ramas.yml
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Acción a ejecutar
        required: true
        default: audit
        type: choice
        options:
          - audit
          - delete
      confirmation:
        description: Para eliminar, escribir ELIMINAR_SOLO_RAMAS_SEGURAS
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: limpieza-ramas-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  audit:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'audit')
    name: Clasificar ramas sin borrar
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Configurar Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Probar protecciones del limpiador
        run: node --test tests/branches/auditar-limpiar-ramas.test.mjs

      - name: Auditar ramas
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          BRANCH_CLEANUP_MODE: audit
          BRANCH_CLEANUP_CONFIRMATION: ''
          # Una PR activa siempre puede dejar ramas en revisión. Allí se
          # informa el inventario sin bloquear; main conserva el gate estricto.
          BRANCH_AUDIT_REQUIRE_ZERO_REVIEW: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
        run: node scripts/auditar-limpiar-ramas.mjs

      - name: Publicar resumen
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f branch-audit.md ]; then
            cat branch-audit.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Guardar informe
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: auditoria-ramas-audit-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            branch-audit.json
            branch-audit.md
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

  delete:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'delete'
    name: Eliminar solo ramas verificadas
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Configurar Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Probar protecciones antes de borrar
        run: node --test tests/branches/auditar-limpiar-ramas.test.mjs

      - name: Eliminar ramas seguras
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          BRANCH_CLEANUP_MODE: delete
          BRANCH_CLEANUP_CONFIRMATION: ${{ inputs.confirmation }}
          BRANCH_AUDIT_REQUIRE_ZERO_REVIEW: 'true'
        run: node scripts/auditar-limpiar-ramas.mjs

      - name: Publicar resumen
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f branch-audit.md ]; then
            cat branch-audit.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Guardar informe
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: auditoria-ramas-delete-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            branch-audit.json
            branch-audit.md
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

name: Auditoría responsive global

      - main

# Esta auditoría instala navegadores y consume el runner durante varios minutos.
# Solo la ejecución más reciente POR RAMA/PR aporta valor; se cancela la anterior
# de esa misma rama. El group va atado a la rama (no un string fijo) para que
# un push en otra rama/PR no cancele esta ejecución.
concurrency:
  group: responsive-global-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  geometry:
    name: Geometría pública en 7 pantallas y límites
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install Playwright
        timeout-minutes: 25
        run: |
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 7m npm install --no-save --package-lock=false; then
              exit 0
            fi
            if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then
              echo "No se pudo instalar Playwright después de 3 intentos" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep $((attempt * 15))
          done

      - name: Install Chromium
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Audit all public pages and shared surfaces
        id: geometry
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: npm run audit:global-responsive-geometry > global-responsive-geometry.log 2>&1

      - name: Upload report and failure screenshots
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: global-responsive-geometry
          path: |
            global-responsive-geometry.log
            artifacts/global-responsive
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Enforce responsive geometry
        run: |
          cat global-responsive-geometry.log
          test "${{ steps.geometry.outcome }}" = "success"

name: Preparar upgrade temporal de Actions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - chatgpt/production-surgical-hardening

  contents: write

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Generar bundle de workflows actualizados
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json

          root = Path('.github/workflows')
          replacements = {
              'actions/setup-java@v5': 'actions/setup-java@v5',
              'actions/upload-artifact@v6': 'actions/upload-artifact@v6',
              'actions/upload-artifact@v6': 'actions/upload-artifact@v6',
              'actions/download-artifact@v6': 'actions/download-artifact@v6',
              'actions/download-artifact@v6': 'actions/download-artifact@v6',
          }
          elements = []
          changed = []
          for path in sorted(root.glob('*.y*ml')):
              original = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
              updated = original
              for old, new in replacements.items():
                  updated = updated.replace(old, new)
              if path.name == 'entrega-final-fase-12.yml':
                  updated = updated.replace(
                      'npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=critical',
                      'npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate'
                  )
              if updated != original:
                  changed.append(str(path))
                  elements.append({
                      'path': str(path),
                      'mode': '100644',
                      'type': 'blob',
                      'content': updated,
                  })
          if not elements:
              raise SystemExit('No se encontraron workflows para actualizar.')
          Path('workflow-upgrades-tree.json').write_text(
              json.dumps({'tree_elements': elements, 'changed': changed}, ensure_ascii=False),
              encoding='utf-8'
          )
          print('Workflows preparados:', len(changed))
          print('\n'.join(changed))
          PY
      - name: Guardar únicamente el bundle no ejecutable
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add workflow-upgrades-tree.json
          git commit -m "chore: preparar bundle temporal de actualización de Actions"
          git push origin HEAD:chatgpt/production-surgical-hardening

      - '*.html'
      - 'tienda.js'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'manifest.json'
      - 'robots.txt'
      - 'sitemap.xml'
      - 'scripts/auditar-fase-11-seo.js'
      - 'scripts/auditar-produccion-salud.mjs'
      - 'tests/seo/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/seo-produccion-fase-11.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 * * * *'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  seo-contracts:
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Instalar Chromium para Playwright
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run audit:phase11
      - run: npm run test:phase11-seo

  production-health:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run monitor:production
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        if: always()
        with:
          name: phase11-production-health
          path: artifacts/phase11-production-health.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
